t_advice_summary_textbox.text: follow the 1x multiplyer and remember colour, take notice of which colour generates the biggest harvest.

vb_textbox.text: use the lower multiplier round to determine which is the highest value i found if you click one and its around 6 its the colour to go for. in my experience of the games colours that closely match tended to be of the same value i.e brown and orange, purple and pink. good luck.
